components.text: This Sigil can hold up to 5 other Sigils at a time, providing you with their passive effects and allowing you to activate them on a whim. Use the configured keybinds (check your controls menu) to open its inventory and cycle between the held sigils - holding sneak and using your mousewheel also works.
Crafted in two steps: first a Holding Reagent at the Alchemy Table, then combine it with a Blank Slate in an Alchemy Array to produce the finished Sigil.
